note: Two columns on the page image. Left column (headings lines 1-3 'P. L. 94-142, TITLE VI-B TEACHERS', and 19-20 'SPECIAL NEEDS AIDES, TEACHING ASSISTANTS, AND TUTORS'): special-needs staff. Right column (headings lines 1-2 '- TEACHING STAFF - (Lunenburg High School)'): High School teachers, school high (page school). Left-column schools set from each person's own position text: Aubuchon 'High School Resource Room', Howard 'High School Core Chairperson', Putnam 'High School' -> high; 'Elementary School'/'Elem. School' (Anderson speech therapy line 21, Brown, Kondig, O'Brien, Paquette, Shepard, Whittenkraus) -> passios (assumes 'Elementary School' means Passios, the K-5 building; the Primary School is named separately); DeMar 'Primary School' -> primary; Watson, Kyajohnian 'Middle School' -> turkey-hill; Wilson 'Adjustment Counselor/School Psychologist (Office: Middle School)' -> turkey-hill by printed office; Stachow splits 12 hrs Elem. and 23 hrs Middle -> district-wide; Anderson line 4 (Teacher of Hearing Impaired) names no school -> district-wide. Line 62 'SPED Tutor' is Whittenkraus's title (name on line 63). Cronin's title is split over lines 29-32. Lines holding only dates, years, hours, FTE, resignation/replacement notes, or homeroom numbers, and the page number (73), are ignored. Line 12 '1983 Summer School Director effective July 1, 1983' is Angevine's added duty and is ignored.
